### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

Running **Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8** in **PD-disaggregation (1 prefill + 1 decode node)** with **MoRI EP all-to-all** and **`--enable-dp-attention`** (TP8/EP8/DP8) on MI355X/ROCm, both prefill and decode servers now start cleanly and reach `Application startup complete`, but the benchmark completes **0 successful requests**. On first traffic, every decode DP rank fails to reach the prefill **disaggregation bootstrap server** (`--disaggregation-bootstrap-port`, default `8998`):

```
Error querying dp_ranks from bootstrap: HTTPConnectionPool(host='172.18.170.23', port=8998):
Max retries exceeded with url: /query_dp_ranks
(Caused by NewConnectionError("HTTPConnection(host='172.18.170.23', port=8998):
Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno 99] Cannot assign requested address"))
```

The message repeats **~1.36 million times in a single run** — a `/query_dp_ranks` connect/retry storm that exhausts client ephemeral ports (`[Errno 99]`), so the prefill↔decode KV-transfer handshake never establishes and no request completes. `benchmark_serving` reports `Successful requests: 0` with all throughput/latency metrics `0.00`.

(This is reached after applying the model-init/kernel fixes so the servers can load and serve — see "Applied fixes" below. It is a separate layer — the disaggregation bootstrap/handshake — from the shared-expert-fusion assertion (#31793), the idle-rank zero-grid HIP abort (#31794/#31350), and the decode CUDA-graph/MoRI routing (#32039), all of which are resolved here.)

### Root cause (suspected)

Under dp-attention with per-rank EP (MoRI), each of the 8 decode DP ranks issues `GET http://<prefill>:8998/query_dp_ranks` to resolve DP-rank info for the KV-transfer handshake. The query appears to be issued **per-DP-rank without connection pooling / backoff / caching**, so on a topology where the connection cannot be immediately established, the ranks spin in a tight connect-retry loop and exhaust local ephemeral ports (`[Errno 99] Cannot assign requested address`) rather than backing off or querying once per node. The result is a request-serving deadlock: servers are up and healthy, but the disaggregation handshake never completes.

### Proposed fix

- Add connection pooling + bounded retry/backoff to the decode-side `/query_dp_ranks` bootstrap query (reuse a session; cap retries; exponential backoff) so a transiently-unreachable bootstrap does not turn into a millions-of-connections ephemeral-port storm.
- Consider querying the bootstrap **once per node** (or caching the DP-rank map) instead of once per DP rank per request under dp-attention + MoRI.
- Surface a single clear error (bootstrap unreachable at `host:8998`) instead of an unbounded retry loop.

### Applied fixes (source overlays; required just to reach this point)

The tested image predates the fixes, so these merged/open PRs were applied by bind-mounting patched source files (read-only) over the image's originals under `/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/...`:

- **#31793** — disable Qwen global-slot shared-expert fusion under per-rank EP backends. File: `srt/models/qwen2_moe.py`.
- **#31794** (fixes #31350) — idle-DP-rank zero-grid guards + MoRI EP routing. Files: `srt/models/qwen2_moe.py`, `srt/models/utils.py`, `srt/layers/sampler.py`, `srt/layers/attention/linear/gdn_backend.py`, `jit_kernel/triton/gdn_fused_proj.py`.
- **#32039** — MoRI expert routing, decode CUDA-graph disable under MoRI normal mode, AITER buffer capacity. Files: `srt/models/qwen2_moe.py`, `srt/layers/attention/aiter_backend.py`, `srt/server_args.py`.

With all three applied, init is clean (shared-expert fusion auto-disabled at `moe_ep_size=8`; no `invalid configuration argument`; decode CUDA graph auto-disabled for MoRI normal mode; both servers load 94/94 shards and reach `Application startup complete`). The bug in this report is what remains after that.

### Reproduction

1. Apply #31793 + #31794 + #32039 to `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.14-rocm720-mi35x-20260706` (source overlays as above).
2. Launch PD-disaggregation on two MI355X nodes (1 prefill + 1 decode), TP8/EP8/DP8, dp-attention on, MoRI transfer/EP backend:

**Prefill:**
```
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 \
  --disaggregation-mode prefill --disaggregation-ib-device ionic_0,...,ionic_7 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --ep-size 8 --dp-size 8 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --attention-backend aiter \
  --disaggregation-transfer-backend mori --moe-dense-tp-size 1 --moe-a2a-backend mori \
  --enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --max-running-requests 256 --chunked-prefill-size 65536 \
  --cuda-graph-bs 1 2 3 --disable-radix-cache
```

**Decode:**
```
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 \
  --disaggregation-mode decode --disaggregation-ib-device ionic_0,...,ionic_7 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --ep-size 8 --dp-size 8 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --attention-backend aiter \
  --disaggregation-transfer-backend mori --moe-dense-tp-size 1 --moe-a2a-backend mori \
  --enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --max-running-requests 256 --prefill-round-robin-balance
```

**Router:** `python3 -m sglang_router.launch_router --pd-disaggregation --port 30000 --policy random --prefill http://<prefill>:8000 --decode http://<decode>:8000`

3. Send traffic (e.g. `benchmark_serving`, random dataset, ISL 8192 / OSL 1024, concurrency 256). Observe every decode DP rank spamming `Error querying dp_ranks from bootstrap ... :8998 ... [Errno 99] Cannot assign requested address` and `Successful requests: 0`.

Env (both roles): `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `SGLANG_MORI_COMBINE_DTYPE`, `SGLANG_MORI_MOE_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS`, `SGLANG_MORI_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK`.

### Full error (repeats ~1.36M times across the 8 decode DP ranks)

```
[2026-07-31 06:35:17 DP0 TP0 EP0] Error querying dp_ranks from bootstrap: HTTPConnectionPool(host='172.18.170.23', port=8998): Max retries exceeded with url: /query_dp_ranks (Caused by NewConnectionError("HTTPConnection(host='172.18.170.23', port=8998): Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno 99] Cannot assign requested address"))
... (same on DP1..DP7, continuously) ...
```

`benchmark_serving` result:
```
============ Serving Benchmark Result ============
Successful requests:                     0
Benchmark duration (s):                  4.45
Total input / generated tokens:          0 / 0
Request / Output / Total throughput:     0.00 / 0.00 / 0.00
```

### Environment

- Container: `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.14-rocm720-mi35x-20260706` (+ source overlays for #31793 / #31794 / #32039)
- sglang: 0.5.14
- GPU: AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) x8, 1 prefill + 1 decode node
- ROCm: 7.2
- Model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8
- Attention backend: aiter; MoE a2a backend: mori; disaggregation transfer backend: mori; `deepep_mode=normal`
- Topology: 1P+1D, TP8 / EP8 / DP8, `--enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head`
- Disaggregation bootstrap port: 8998 (default)
title: [Bug][AMD] Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 disagg + dp-attention: decode DP ranks flood `/query_dp_ranks` bootstrap → `[Errno 99] Cannot assign requested address`, 0 successful requests
